description:
Copy a file session — files, approved proofs, and completed check results — into a NEW file session, leaving the original and its configuration join untouched. Optionally link the CLONE to a configuration session in the same call.

Use this instead of link_file_session whenever the source file session is one a page is currently displaying: linking would MOVE the single join pointer and strip the files off that page, while cloning gives the target configuration its own copy. Typical case: the customer is on a product page and selects a recommended candidate — clone the page's file session and link the clone to the candidate's configuration session.

Returns the new **fileSessionId** (the clone), the sourceFileSessionId, and fileCount.

fileSessionId.description: Source file session ID to copy.

productConfigSessionId.description: Configuration session ID to link the CLONE to (e.g. the selected candidate).

name: clone_file_session
